title: OperationAssignmentV2
description: RabbitMQ assignment envelope published after a Go scheduler placement decision. The control service commits Operation QUEUED -> ASSIGNED, a SchedulingDecision, and a worker-targeted outbox row, then the Java publisher sends this JSON to routing key worker.{workerId}. Ownership is still established later at POST /internal/operations/{id}/start (attemptId + workerId + lease). v2 does not include attemptId.
